fields.name: LoggingExtensions.ReaderStateEvents
fields.contract: The degenerate-result-state event family: DataReaderIsNull(ILogger, string sprocName, string connectionName) and DataReaderIsClosed(ILogger, string sprocName, string connectionName) each log at Error under event id MapperResultsReaderInvalid (7) that the data reader expected from the named procedure/connection was null, respectively already closed. EmptyResult(ILogger, string queryName) logs at Debug under event id UnexpectedDbNull (6) that a query returned no rows at all. NullShardChildArguments<TRecord,TChild>(ILogger, string propertyName, ShardKey<TRecord,TChild> shardChild), the type's only generic member, logs at Information under event id UnexpectedDbNull (6), event name NullShardChildArguments, that a two-part ShardKey could not be built because an input value was null — but only when Information is enabled and the key's RecordId or ChildId is null. A value-typed identity can never be null, so a key whose identities are both value types never logs; the shard id is a short and is not checked. The sibling delegate `_sqlShardKeyNull`, compiled for a single-column shard-key-null message under the same event id, is never invoked by any method in this file — there is no public or internal wrapper for it.
